description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConnectionController class and associated components in a Swift iOS project. It includes test cases for display name resolution, capability reflection, command inclusion, operator connection options, permissions, and loading/storing last gateway connection settings.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayNameSetsDefaultWhenMissing
methods.description: Test that the default display name is set when missing in user defaults.

methods.name: currentCapsReflectToggles
methods.description: Test that the current capabilities reflect the toggled settings in user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsIncludeLocationWhenEnabled
methods.description: Test that location commands are included when location is enabled.

methods.name: currentCommandsExcludeDangerousSystemExecCommands
methods.description: Test that dangerous system commands are excluded from current commands.

methods.name: operatorConnectOptionsOnlyRequestApprovalScopeWhenEnabled
methods.description: Test that operator connect options only include the approval scope when enabled.

methods.name: operatorApprovalScopeRequestsStayBackwardCompatible
methods.description: Test that approval scope requests maintain backward compatibility.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReadsSavedValues
methods.description: Test that loading the last connection reads and returns the saved values correctly.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReturnsNilForInvalidData
methods.description: Test that loading last connection returns nil when the stored data is invalid.
